subject: Private deployment onboarding: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on-prem package - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@astralcare.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment onboarding: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on-prem package - next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for AstralCare's private deployment. Per our call last week, I wanted to kick off coordination for the VPC peering, private endpoints, and the on-prem package delivery so we can lock in an implementation window.

Proposed agenda for a 30–45 min kickoff:
- Network inventory & primary contacts (VPC IDs, CIDR ranges, VPN/BGP ownership)
- Private endpoint pattern (ALB/NLB, internal load balancing)
- On-prem package logistics (shipping, staging, HSM/KMS handoff)
- Security and compliance checks (audit log retention, service account scope)
- Tentative install windows and maintenance blackout dates

Can you confirm the best network contact(s) and share a preferred timezone for a kickoff this week or early next? We’ve attached a short onboarding checklist and a sample peering template to make the network ask explicit.

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (summary), vpc-peering-template.yaml (sample)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@astralcare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: AstralCare IT <it@astralcare.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on-prem package - next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the outline. Our network lead (David Park) is out today but copied IT alias here. A couple quick answers and questions to make the kickoff productive:

- Primary VPC CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 (us-east-1), secondary for staging 10.11.0.0/16.
- We use AWS Transit Gateway; peering will need TGW attachments (not classic VPC peering).
- For on-prem, we’ll need an expected ETA for physical appliance and the list of required ports. Also need to understand HSM/KMS integration patterns for key management — do you support customer-managed keys in HSM?

We can do a quick kickoff Thursday 07/24 10:00–10:45 PT or Friday 07/25 08:00–08:45 PT. Which works on your side?

I’ll attach the IP allocation spreadsheet after I confirm with David.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Infrastructure | AstralCare
alex.johnson@astralcare.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@astralcare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on-prem package - next steps

On Tue, Jul 22, 2025 at 11:03 AM Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@astralcare.com> wrote:
> Our network lead (David Park) is out today but copied IT alias here.
> We use AWS Transit Gateway; peering will need TGW attachments (not classic VPC peering).

Thanks for the context, Alex. A few notes ahead of the kickoff:

- We support TGW-based connectivity patterns; our ops will create a cross-account TGW attachment and the minimal route table changes on the Redwood side.
- For private endpoints, Redwood prefers customer NLBs with internal targets in front of the appliance; we can provide a short Terraform snippet if you want to automate the endpoint creation.
- HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed keys via a few patterns — either ACM-backed encryption + KMS CMK (customer account) or direct HSM integration for FIPS workloads. Laura is the PM for the on-prem package and will share the packaging checklist and shipping SLA.

Links: network diagram (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/astralcare/network-diagram.pdf
Template: vpc-peering-template.yaml (attached).

Prep asks for kickoff:
1) Confirm TGW ID and account ID that will attach.
2) Confirm a temporary maintenance window (2–4 hours) for cutover testing.
3) If you plan to use HSM, share required cipher suites and HSM vendor if available.

Happy to take the lead on the technical portion in the kickoff. We’ll make the meeting notes and next steps explicit.

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0147
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@astralcare.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on-prem package - next steps

Alex —

A few connectivity items from the network side (so you can review with David):

- Redwood expects a /27 for management (private endpoints) and a /24 for service traffic behind the NLB. Please confirm final allocation in the sheet.
- TGW peering: we will request TGW: tgw-0a1b2c3d4e from our account and need the customer TGW attachment ID when you create it.
- BGP: we support EBGP session to your edge. Advertised prefixes should include the service /24 and a small set of healthcheck IPs.
- Firewall rules: allow inbound from our management /27 to ports 443, 22 (for support VPN), 8443 (control plane), and ephemeral high ports for health probes.
- Maintenance window: recommend a 3-hour window starting 22:00 UTC to minimize production traffic impact.

We’ll open Jira IMPL-4821 and attach the peering config there. Can someone on your side provide the public ASN and the planned BGP neighbor IP?

Attachments: none here, but Marissa I’ll coordinate with Laura on the on-prem shipping ETA so we can sequence cutover.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Network Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@astralcare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: AstralCare IT <it@astralcare.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on-prem package - next steps

Thanks all —

Confirming Thursday 07/24 10:00 PT for the kickoff.

Quick answers for Aditya: public ASN 64512 (we’ll confirm via David), BGP neighbor planned IP 3.120.34.70/30 (provisioned on our edge), and we will allocate the /27 management and the /24 service networks; I attached the allocation sheet for clarity.

On HSM/KMS: we plan to use AWS KMS CMKs in our account for most keys; we may bring an HSM for HIPAA-sensitive workloads later — we’ll surface the vendor and cipher suite if we go that route.

Attached: astralcare-ip-allocation.xlsx

Appreciate the clear asks. See you Thursday.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Infrastructure | AstralCare
